motion_system: Hold the plate still at rest. On intentional interaction, move one short diffraction highlight along the existing source cut and slightly separate its shadow gap; never animate the whole arc or continuously pulse the field.
color_drift: Keep chalk, burnt orange, peach and charcoal stable. Confine any transient silver-to-cyan-to-violet shift to the active bevel; keep the cobalt reflection compact and stationary.
glow_behavior: Use reflected light rather than emitted glow. Highlights stop at physical cuts, leaving the underside and dropout dark; no halo or hotspot outline.
